title: Make a text view
summary: Django: Make a text view. Change the greeting.
introduction: A view is a function that returns a response. path connects the empty path to hello. Open GET /.
learningObjectives: Make a text view with Django

blocks.text: Install django~=5.2, run django-admin startproject school, then enter school. Replace school/urls.py with each example and run python manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:8000. These view examples need no database tables.

blocks.title: Make a text view

blocks.text: urlpatterns maps the empty path to hello. The view returns an HttpResponse containing the greeting.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Django path patterns do not start with a slash.
